"'''Someone You Loved'''" is a song by Scottish singer-songwriter [[Lewis Capaldi]]. It was released on November 8, 2018 via digital download through [[Vertigo Records]], as the third single from his second extended play, ''[[Breach (Lewis Capaldi EP)|Breach]]'' (2018). The song was later included on his debut studio album, ''[[Divinely Uninspired to a Hellish Extent]]'' (2019). It was written by Capaldi, [[Romans (musician)|Samuel Romans]], and its producers [[TMS (production team)|Thomas Barnes]], [[TMS (production team)|Peter Kelleher]] and [[TMS (production team)|Benjamin Kohn]]. The song was sent to radio stations on April 16, 2019 as the album's first single in the United States.

"Someone You Loved" was a commercial success, peaking at No. 1 on the [[UK Singles Chart]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.billboard.com/articles/business/chart-beat/8541081/lewis-capaldi-someone-you-loved-number-one-hot-100|title=Lewis Capaldi's 'Someone You Loved' Hits No. 1 on Billboard Hot 100|website=www.billboard.com}}</ref> The song became Capaldi's first No. 1 single, spending seven consecutive weeks atop the chart and was the best selling single of 2019 in the UK. It also peaked at No. 1 on the [[Irish Singles Chart]], the [[Canadian Hot 100]], and the [[Recording Industry Association of Malaysia]] singles chart. In the United States, "Someone You Loved" was a [[sleeper hit]], topping the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] in its 24th week on the chart. The song is certified Diamond or higher in Australia, Brazil, Canada, France, Germany, Poland, Philippines, Thailand, and the United States. It was nominated for [[Grammy Award for Song of the Year|Song of the Year]] at the [[62nd Grammy Awards]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.grammy.com/news/song-year-nominees-revealed-2020-grammy-awards|title= Song Of The Year Nominees Revealed |last=Brodsky|first=Rachel|date=20 November 2019|website=Grammy.com|language=en-US|access-date=5 January 2020}}</ref> It also received an award for [[Brit Award for Song of the Year|Song of the Year]] at the [[2020 Brit Awards]]. In early August 2025, on the streaming app [[Spotify]], the song became the [[List of Spotify streaming records#Most streamed songs|fourth song to reach 4 billion streams on the app]].

"Someone You Loved" is a song by Scottish singer-songwriter Lewis Capaldi. It was released on November 8, 2018 via digital download through Vertigo Records, as the third single from his second extended play, Breach (2018). The song was later included on his debut studio album, Divinely Uninspired to a Hellish Extent (2019). It was written by Capaldi, Samuel Romans, and its producers Thomas Barnes, Peter Kelleher and Benjamin Kohn. The song was sent to radio stations on April 16, 2019 as the album's first single in the United States.

"Someone You Loved" was a commercial success, peaking at No. 1 on the UK Singles Chart. The song became Capaldi's first No. 1 single, spending seven consecutive weeks atop the chart and was the best selling single of 2019 in the UK. It also peaked at No. 1 on the Irish Singles Chart, the Canadian Hot 100, and the Recording Industry Association of Malaysia singles chart. In the United States, "Someone You Loved" was a sleeper hit, topping the Billboard Hot 100 in its 24th week on the chart. The song is certified Diamond or higher in Australia, Brazil, Canada, France, Germany, Poland, Philippines, Thailand, and the United States. It was nominated for Song of the Year at the 62nd Grammy Awards. It also received an award for Song of the Year at the 2020 Brit Awards. In early August 2025, on the streaming app Spotify, the song became the fourth song to reach 4 billion streams on the app.

sections.heading: Background and composition
sections.wikitext:
"Someone You Loved" is played in the [[tempo]] of 110 BPM and key signature of [[D-flat major|D♭ major]]. In an interview with the French magazine ''Brut'', Capaldi revealed he wrote the song about his grandmother who had died.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.brut.media/fr/entertainment/tour-en-bus-avec-lewis-capaldi-82980a8c-91b4-4e39-bd7c-b4cfbf1f156e | title=Tour en bus avec Lewis Capaldi }}</ref>

In an interview with the British website ''[[NME]]'', Capaldi said that it took him six months to write the song. He said, "A lot of people say that 'the best songs fall into your lap' and that they're the easiest ones to write and take the shortest amount of time: I wholeheartedly disagree with that. I think my best songs come from me sitting at a [[piano]], bashing my head against a brick wall for hours and hours on end to get one good melody."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/news/music/lewis-capaldi-someone-you-loved-lyrics-song-meaning-2465520|title=Lewis Capaldi explains meaning and inspiration behind Number One single 'Someone You Loved'|last=Moore|first=Sam|date=22 March 2019|website=NME|language=en-US|access-date=7 April 2019}}</ref>

sections.heading: Critical reception
sections.wikitext: Reviewer Dave Simpson of ''[[The Guardian]]'' gave the song four stars out of five, calling it and its heartbreak theme "raw and real."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2020/mar/03/lewis-capaldi-review-apollo-manchester|title=Lewis Capaldi review – the tears of pop's characterful clown|work=The Guardian|date=March 3, 2020|author=Dave Simpson}}</ref>

sections.heading: Music videos
sections.wikitext:
The first music video was published on 28 February 2019 in partnership with an [[organ donation]] [[Charity (practice)|charity]], ''Live Life Give Life''. This music video featured Capaldi's distant relative ([[Cousin|second cousin once removed]]),{{efn|Peter's paternal great-[[Grandparent|grandfather]] is Lewis' paternal great-great-grandfather}} actor [[Peter Capaldi]] as a bereaved husband who finds some joy when he visits the family of the woman his wife donated her heart to, and is able to listen to her heartbeat one last time.{{cite magazine |first=Huw |last=Fullerton |title=Peter Capaldi stars in moving music video for his distant relative, and fans love it |magazine=[[Radio Times]] |date=2019-02-10 |url=https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/sci-fi/peter-capaldi-stars-in-moving-music-video-for-his-distant-relative-and-fans-love-it/ |access-date=2026-04-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422181929/https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/sci-fi/peter-capaldi-stars-in-moving-music-video-for-his-distant-relative-and-fans-love-it/ |archive-date=2021-04-22 |url-status=live |quote=...previously told press that Peter was a second cousin once removed.}} The second music video, featuring the singer himself, was released on 29 August 2019.{{Cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zABLecsR5UE|title=Lewis Capaldi – Someone You Loved (Official Video)|date=29 August 2019|via=[[YouTube]]|access-date=30 August 2019}} In the start, Capaldi wanders the streets, following his lost love as his friends and strangers try to stop him from chasing after her. His brother, Aidan, also made an appearance at the beginning of the video where he pulls Lewis from the bench. The director of the music video, Ozzie Pullin, said:
The first person Lewis encounters is his brother, who pulls him up from the bench. This was an almost perfect metaphor because family members are usually the first people to push you forward.{{YouTube|id=3joxJRm9r9E|title=Lewis Capaldi - Someone You Loved (Official Behind The Scenes)}}{{Cite web |title=Lewis Capaldi - The Making of 'Someone You Loved' (Vevo Footnotes) |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o6aOigx9uu0 |website=[[YouTube]]| date=29 August 2022 }}
Capaldi said:
For me the video is about the people we surround ourselves with that have the strength when we don't and help us continue to make the right decisions in moments of fear or hardship. In the moment we often choose to ignore friends and family, thinking our judgement is better, but of course in hindsight when you're in that headspace it's almost impossible to make the right decisions.{{Cite web |url=https://www.udiscovermusic.com/news/lewis-capaldi-someone-you-loved-video/ |title=Lewis Capaldi Debuts The Official Video For 'Someone You Loved' |date=29 August 2019 |via=udiscovermusic |access-date=10 November 2019}}
sections.text:
The first music video was published on 28 February 2019 in partnership with an organ donation charity, Live Life Give Life. This music video featured Capaldi's distant relative (second cousin once removed),{{efn|Peter's paternal great-grandfather is Lewis' paternal great-great-grandfather}} actor Peter Capaldi as a bereaved husband who finds some joy when he visits the family of the woman his wife donated her heart to, and is able to listen to her heartbeat one last time. The second music video, featuring the singer himself, was released on 29 August 2019. In the start, Capaldi wanders the streets, following his lost love as his friends and strangers try to stop him from chasing after her. His brother, Aidan, also made an appearance at the beginning of the video where he pulls Lewis from the bench. The director of the music video, Ozzie Pullin, said:
The first person Lewis encounters is his brother, who pulls him up from the bench. This was an almost perfect metaphor because family members are usually the first people to push you forward.
Capaldi said:
For me the video is about the people we surround ourselves with that have the strength when we don't and help us continue to make the right decisions in moments of fear or hardship. In the moment we often choose to ignore friends and family, thinking our judgement is better, but of course in hindsight when you're in that headspace it's almost impossible to make the right decisions.

sections.heading: Chart performance
sections.wikitext:
"Someone You Loved" reached No. 1 on the [[UK Singles Chart]]<ref name="UK"/> and stayed there for seven consecutive weeks.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.officialcharts.com/chart-news/lewis-capaldis-someone-you-loved-scores-a-seventh-week-at-number-1-on-the-official-singles-chart__26060/|title=Lewis Capaldi denies Lil Nas X this week's Number 1 single|last=Copsey|first=Rob|date=12 April 2019|publisher=[[Official Charts Company]]|access-date=17 June 2019}}</ref> It is also Capaldi's first entry on the US [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]], debuting at No. 85 on the issue dated 25 May 2019 and becoming the singer's first number-one single in the country on the issue dated 2 November 2019. It reached No. 1 after 24 weeks on the chart, becoming one of the longest climbs to the top position in ''Billboard'' history. After three non-consecutive weeks on top it was replaced by [[Post Malone]]'s "[[Circles (Post Malone song)|Circles]]".<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/articles/business/chart-beat/8541081/lewis-capaldi-someone-you-loved-number-one-hot-100|title=Lewis Capaldi's 'Someone You Loved' Hits No. 1 on Billboard Hot 100|magazine=Billboard}}</ref>

In [[Ireland]], the single cumulated 26.8 million streams in 2019 and was the biggest-selling song in the country that year.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.officialcharts.com/chart-news/irelands-official-top-50-biggest-songs-of-2019__28100/|title=Ireland's Official Top 50 biggest songs of 2019|website=www.officialcharts.com|language=en|access-date=2020-01-10}}</ref>

"Someone You Loved" reached No. 1 on the UK Singles Chart and stayed there for seven consecutive weeks. It is also Capaldi's first entry on the US Billboard Hot 100, debuting at No. 85 on the issue dated 25 May 2019 and becoming the singer's first number-one single in the country on the issue dated 2 November 2019. It reached No. 1 after 24 weeks on the chart, becoming one of the longest climbs to the top position in Billboard history. After three non-consecutive weeks on top it was replaced by Post Malone's "Circles".

In Ireland, the single cumulated 26.8 million streams in 2019 and was the biggest-selling song in the country that year.

sections.heading: Cover versions
sections.wikitext:
* [[The Piano Guys]] covered the song in a piano and cello composition on their video featuring [[World of Dance (season 2)|''World of Dance'' season 2]] contestants [[Charity Anderson]] and Andres Penate.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.utahchannel3.com/2019/12/05/the-piano-guys-bring-christmas-together-tour-to-cedar-city/|title=The Piano Guys bring 'Christmas Together Tour' to Cedar City|date=5 December 2019|access-date=1 March 2020|work=Utah Channel 3}}</ref>
* [[Nicola Roberts]] performed the song in her Queen Bee disguise on the first series of ''[[The Masked Singer (British series 1)|The Masked Singer UK]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rouse |first=Beverley |date=15 February 2020 |title=All is revealed as The Masked Singer crowns winner |url=https://m.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/entertainment/film-tv/news/all-is-revealed-as-the-masked-singer-crowns-winner/38959865.html |access-date=30 April 2023 |newspaper=[[Belfast Telegraph]]}}</ref>
* [[Camila Cabello]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Lewis Capaldi responds to Camila Cabello's 'Someone You Loved' Live Lounge cover |url=https://www.nme.com/news/music/camila-cabello-brass-tinged-cover-lewis-capaldi-someone-you-loved-2553294 |website=[[NME]] |date=3 October 2019 |access-date=6 October 2022}}</ref> and the [[Jonas Brothers]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Jonas Brothers Tug At The Heartstrings With Their Surprising Live Lounge Cover: Watch |url=https://www.mtv.com/news/cixewp/jonas-brothers-live-lounge-cover-lewis-capaldi |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221006140809/https://www.mtv.com/news/cixewp/jonas-brothers-live-lounge-cover-lewis-capaldi |url-status=dead |archive-date=October 6, 2022 |website=[[MTV]] |access-date=6 October 2022}}</ref> covered the song during [[BBC Radio 1]]'s [[Live Lounge]], while [[Bastille (band)|Bastille]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VrbG_LFS0Iw|title=Bastille - Medley (Adele, Lewis Capaldi, Kings Of Leon, Queen & The Killers: Live @ SiriusXM|website=[[YouTube]]|date=15 July 2019 |accessdate=6 October 2022}}</ref> [[Charlie Puth]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9mcCIVjYDYA|title=Someone You Loved (Lewis Capaldi Cover) [LIVE @ SiriusXM]|website=[[YouTube]]|date=8 November 2019 |accessdate=6 October 2022}}</ref> and [[Alec Benjamin]]<ref>{{Cite tweet |user=alecbenjamin |number=1221849217070555137 |title=i tried my best @LewisCapaldi but nobody can sing it like you can !}}</ref> covered the song for [[SiriusXM]].
* Capaldi performed the song as a surprise guest with [[Nina Nesbitt]]<ref>{{Cite tweet |user=ninanesbitt |number=1116284119401496576 |title=thank you @LewisCapaldi for joining me on stage last night for all 1,300 of you at my sold out glasgow show!... }}</ref> and [[James Bay (singer)|James Bay]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Lewis Capaldi & James Bay |url=http://quebec.wknd.fm/emissions/13-le-roadtrip-du-wknd/4736-lewis-capaldi-james-bay |website=[[CJEC-FM|WKND 91.9]] |access-date=6 October 2022}}</ref> at their concerts, and with [[Alicia Keys]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Alicia Keys Duets With Lewis Capaldi At iHeartRadio Music Festival |url=https://www.iheart.com/content/2019-09-21-alicia-keys-duets-with-lewis-capaldi-at-iheartradio-music-festival/ |website=[[iHeartRadio]] |access-date=6 October 2022}}</ref> at the 2019 [[iHeartRadio Music Festival]].
* [[Conor Maynard]] covered the song in September 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-09-08 |title=Someone You Loved - Lewis Capaldi (Conor Maynard Cover) |website=[[YouTube]] |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONcXsba7B30 |access-date=2024-07-25}}</ref>
* [[Chris Daughtry]] covered the song during the [[The Masked Singer (American TV series) season 2|second season]] of ''[[The Masked Singer (US)|The Masked Singer]]'' and would later perform it during the [[COVID-19|2020 pandemic]] "Live from Home" tour
* Australian sibling duo [[Angus & Julia Stone]] released a cover of the song in 2024 for [[Triple J]]'s ''[[Like a Version]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-04-18 |title=Angus & Julia Stone cover Lewis Capaldi 'Someone You Loved' for Like A Version |url=https://www.abc.net.au/triplej/like-a-version/angus-julia-stone-cover-lewis-capaldi-like-a-version/103739620 |access-date=2024-04-21 |website=triple j |language=en-AU}}</ref>
* In 2026, Italian composer Giacomo Bucci included an orchestral arrangement of "Someone You Loved" on ''Mainstream Overtures'', his album of orchestral reinterpretations released on 6 March 2026.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rockit.it/giacomobucci/album/mainstream-overtures/73839 |title=Mainstream Overtures - Giacomo Bucci |website=Rockit |date=2026}}</ref>
sections.text:
* The Piano Guys covered the song in a piano and cello composition on their video featuring World of Dance season 2 contestants Charity Anderson and Andres Penate.
* Nicola Roberts performed the song in her Queen Bee disguise on the first series of The Masked Singer UK.
* Camila Cabello and the Jonas Brothers covered the song during BBC Radio 1's Live Lounge, while Bastille, Charlie Puth, and Alec Benjamin covered the song for SiriusXM.
* Capaldi performed the song as a surprise guest with Nina Nesbitt and James Bay at their concerts, and with Alicia Keys at the 2019 iHeartRadio Music Festival.
* Conor Maynard covered the song in September 2019.
* Chris Daughtry covered the song during the second season of The Masked Singer and would later perform it during the 2020 pandemic "Live from Home" tour
* Australian sibling duo Angus & Julia Stone released a cover of the song in 2024 for Triple J's Like a Version.
* In 2026, Italian composer Giacomo Bucci included an orchestral arrangement of "Someone You Loved" on Mainstream Overtures, his album of orchestral reinterpretations released on 6 March 2026.
